summary: Validated new Radar features for the 'LinkedIn 5/5 vs IPS' explanation flow. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_radar_explain_external.py (7 tests, 7/7 PASS in 2.25s). Covers (1) GET /api/careeros/radar/offers/{id}/explain returns IPS criteria + requirements_rules with source='regles' and status∈{ok,missing,unknown}, re-scores on the fly for rule-based offers; (2) GET /explain → 404 on unknown id; (3) POST /api/careeros/radar/external validates text length (422 on short text), rejects LinkedIn-style URL with the helpful 'Lien illisible … copiez-collez' message (422), and successfully analyzes a pasted 'Chef des opérations' offer → stored as source='externe', method='regles', IPS present, requirements_rules populated with at least one of Bilinguisme/Baccalauréat/DEC/syndiqué/équipe/quart detected; (4) analyzed_today counter unchanged after an external analysis (quota exclusion). (5) Direct unit check on radar_rules: SENIOR regex no longer matches 'chef', PHRASES/LEAD map 'chef des opérations' and team-lead variants to 'encadrement', requirements() surfaces 'Gestion d'équipe / supervision' + 'Santé et sécurité'. FRONTEND (Playwright, authenticated member): 46 radar-explain-btn present on dashboard; opening the sheet shows IPS 58, explain-criteria table, explain-method pill, explain-gap, explain-priority badge, explain-req-rules with the live '6/13 exigences couvertes' total; for IA-scored offers the explain-deep-btn is correctly hidden (only rendered when method !== 'ia'). radar-external-btn opens external-dialog; filling title/company/location/text and submitting external-submit triggers POST /external then auto-opens the explain-panel on the newly stored offer (IPS visible, criteria + requirements). Mobile 390×844: body.scrollWidth=390, window.innerWidth=390, sheet width=390 → no horizontal overflow (sm:!max-w-2xl correctly scoped above the sm breakpoint).
critical_code_review_comments: radar.py GET /explain re-runs _rules() for non-IA offers on every call. This is cheap (regex-only), ensures the IPS and requirements stay consistent after rule changes, and the write happens inside the same request — acceptable but noisy if the member opens the sheet repeatedly. Consider a short memoization (e.g., skip re-score if analyzed_at < 5 min) if traffic grows.

radar.py POST /external: when the member supplies only a URL and S._jobposting() succeeds, we overwrite the member-provided title/company/location only if they were empty — correct. If the URL is a LinkedIn job page (which has no public JobPosting), we return the helpful 422 message. Good UX.

radar_rules.PHRASES uses ASCII keys and runs AFTER norm() in _en(), so accented inputs like 'chef d\'équipe' first get stripped to 'chef d\'equipe' then mapped to 'encadrement equipe' — verified by the unit test. 'Shift lead' and 'team lead' are also mapped.

radar_rules._canon strips a single trailing 's' only on words >4 chars and not ending in 'ss'. Note: 'operations' → 'operation', 'chefs' → 'chef'. This is naive but acceptable for the current skill vocabulary; may over-strip French words like 'bus', 'cas' — none are in SKILLS/LEAD so no false positives today.

radar.py _store() truncates label to 120 and evidence to 200 and caps at 16 items — safe for Mongo doc size. Status is sanitised to 'unknown' if not in the allowed set. Correct defensive handling of model/LLM output.
ScoreExplain.jsx: Sheet width className uses 'sm:!max-w-2xl' as mandated by the task; mobile sheet correctly spans full width (sheet=390 on 390px viewport).

ExternalOffer.jsx submit is disabled when both text and url are empty — matches backend validation. onDone correctly pipes the new offer id into ScoreExplain so the member immediately sees the analysis.

Radar.jsx guards <PageTour radar-tour/> with !settings so the tour never fights the settings dialog. The new 'Analyser une offre externe' button also closes the tour before opening — consistent with the Settings button.
Radar.jsx wires explain button only when o.ips exists (condition 'o.ips &&') — prevents a broken sheet on offers that haven't been scored yet. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (explain sheet opens, criteria/req/method/gap visible, external dialog analyses and chains into explain, mobile 390px no overflow)

seed_data_creation: Two external offers created under source='externe' for TEST_UI_RONA and TEST_RONA/TEST_RONA_QUOTA (test_external_create_and_persist / test_external_does_not_count_against_quota / UI flow). Both auto-ignored at end of test where possible; still visible in the 'Opportunités ignorées' section of the dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: localStorage auth key is 'careeros.tokens' (JSON {access_token, refresh_token}). Seed with the login response before navigating to any /careeros/* route to skip the login form. The explain-deep-btn is only rendered for rule-scored offers (method !== 'ia'); when testing an IA-scored offer, don't assert on it. The ExternalOffer.onDone callback chains into ScoreExplain, so after clicking external-submit, wait for data-testid='explain-panel' rather than for a toast.
